# Default background photo

`default-wide.webp` (1920×1280) and `default-portrait.webp` (1080×1920 crop) are resized from:

- **House in forest** (Kersko, Hradištko, Czechia), photo by **Flo Pappert** ([unsplash.com/@flopt](https://unsplash.com/@flopt))
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:House_in_forest_(Unsplash).jpg (originally https://unsplash.com/photos/kspRwqFxOms, published 2017 under the Unsplash CC0 licence)
- Licence: **CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)**, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No attribution is legally required; it is given here as a courtesy.
